# Dashboard Spec Format

**Purpose:** Every dashboard request — whether typed by a human or generated by an LLM — must produce a JSON file in exactly this format. The renderer reads this file to build the HTML dashboard. Think of it as the "blueprint" handed from the planner to the builder.

---

## Top-level structure

```json
{
  "title":       "string — the dashboard headline shown at the top",
  "description": "string — one sentence explaining what this dashboard answers",
  "filters":     { ...see Filters section... },
  "charts":      [ ...array of Chart objects... ],
  "layout":      [ ...array of Layout entries... ]
}
```

---

## Filters object

Filters apply globally to the whole dashboard (every chart respects them unless it overrides with its own `time_range`).

```json
"filters": {
  "date_range": "all | last_6_months | last_year | last_2_years | this_year",
  "state":      "all | CA | TX | FL | ...",
  "product":    "all | auto | home",
  "channel":    "all | agent | direct | broker"
}
```

| Field | Allowed Values | Notes |
|-------|---------------|-------|
| `date_range` | `all`, `last_6_months`, `this_year`, `last_year`, `last_2_years` | Applied to the primary date column of the source table |
| `state` | `all` or any 2-letter US state code | `all` means no state filter |
| `product` | `all`, `auto`, `home` | |
| `channel` | `all`, `agent`, `direct`, `broker` | |

---

## Chart object

Each entry in the `charts` array defines one chart panel.

```json
{
  "chart_id":   "string — unique ID used in layout, e.g. chart_1",
  "chart_type": "bar | line | pie",
  "title":      "string — the chart's own heading",
  "metric":     "string — what to measure (see Metrics table below)",
  "grouping":   "string — what to break it down by (see Groupings table below)",
  "time_range": "string — same values as date_range in Filters",
  "sort_order": "asc | desc | none"
}
```

### Supported Metrics

| Metric Key | What It Measures | Source Table | Date Column Used |
|-----------|-----------------|-------------|-----------------|
| `count_quotes` | Number of quotes | quotes | quote_date |
| `conversion_rate` | % of quotes that bound (became policies) | quotes | quote_date |
| `sum_premium` | Total annual premium written | policies | effective_date |
| `count_claims` | Number of claims filed | claims | claim_date |
| `sum_claim_amount` | Total dollar value of claims | claims | claim_date |
| `avg_claim_amount` | Average dollar value per claim | claims | claim_date |

### Supported Groupings

| Grouping Key | Groups By | Works With |
|-------------|----------|-----------|
| `state` | US state (2-letter code) | all metrics |
| `product` | auto / home | all metrics |
| `channel` | agent / direct / broker | count_quotes, conversion_rate, sum_premium |
| `month_product` | Calendar month + product line | count_claims, sum_claim_amount (line charts) |

---

## Layout array

Defines the grid position of each chart. Row 1 is the top row; Col 1 is the left column. Charts in the same row appear side by side.

```json
"layout": [
  { "chart_id": "chart_1", "row": 1, "col": 1 },
  { "chart_id": "chart_2", "row": 1, "col": 2 },
  { "chart_id": "chart_3", "row": 2, "col": 1 }
]
```

---

## Full example (minimal)

```json
{
  "title": "My Dashboard",
  "description": "One-sentence answer to the business question.",
  "filters": {
    "date_range": "last_6_months",
    "state": "all",
    "product": "all",
    "channel": "all"
  },
  "charts": [
    {
      "chart_id": "chart_1",
      "chart_type": "bar",
      "title": "Quote Volume by State",
      "metric": "count_quotes",
      "grouping": "state",
      "time_range": "last_6_months",
      "sort_order": "desc"
    }
  ],
  "layout": [
    { "chart_id": "chart_1", "row": 1, "col": 1 }
  ]
}
```
